notes:
Lead from PLG signup. Indie two-person startup (founder + eng contractor). Wants to embed a tiny writing assistant in their electron-based note app. Signed up via self-serve on 2026-03-01 and started basic testing.

Key points from initial trial and short call (03/05):
- "Will probably start <50k tokens/mo, want predictable per-request cost.", founder said.
- Use-case: short prompts + structured completions (title, summary, bullets) — looks like quick-generation + summarization.
- Latency preference: snappy UX — ideally <200ms p99 for single-turn completions; will tolerate up to ~400ms for heavier summary jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Wants to understand batching, min_token pricing, streaming options to avoid wasted tokens.
- Model preference: open to small/fast models. Asked about Redwood verified models and quantized variants.
- Routing: no multi-region needs; entirely NA public cloud.
- Security: no enterprise SSO; wants data not retained beyond 7 days if possible. Asks about audit logging but low priority.

Behavior in account: created API key, ran a few calls from dev machine, observed 2-3 429s during spike (likely rate-limits). Reached out via in-app help; we created ticket INF-198 to verify client-side retry headers.

Notes: Tone is pragmatic. Founder: "We just need something that works, cheap and fast. If cost math lines up we could bump to paid in 2 months."

Recommended rep action: keep AE touch light — send concise onboarding + clear pricing calc for 10k/50k/200k tokens, show streaming & cost saving tips (batching, short-max-tokens). Attach quick example SDK snippet for electron context.
